data.title: Guinea-Bissau vs Nigeria Preview and Betting Tips - Expect Goals in Open AFCON Qualifier
data.content:
Nigeria have looked sharp in attack lately, scoring in their last seven matches in all competitions. However, they have also been a bit too open at the back, having conceded in the last three fixtures in this run.

## Team News & Predicted Line-ups

Guinea-Bissau (4-4-2): Fernando Embadje; Jefferson Encada, Opa Sangante, Victor Rofino, Iano Imbene; Franculino Dju, Dalcio, Ronaldo Vieira, Mama Balde; Beto, Renato Nhanga. [...] Nigeria came away from their opening fixture with no injuries and suspensions. Ilenikhena could be handed another start in attack after scoring on his debut, while Semi Ajayi and Calvin Bassey should continue in central defence.

## Verdict

Guinea-Bissau are struggling to keep things tight defensively, while Nigeria have also looked open at the back lately.

There is attacking quality to capitalize on each other's weaknesses, and both teams can be backed to score here. [...] Guinea-Bissau are not expected to make too many changes to the team, with Franculino and Balde set to retain their places. Beto should feature in attack once again while Opa Sangante is set to line up at the back.

Nigeria (4-4-2): Stanley Nwabali; Ola Aina, Semi Ajayi, Calvin Bassey, Bruno Onyemaechi, Samuel Chukwueze, Wilfred Ndidi, Alex Iwobi, Ademola Lookman; Akor Adams, George Ilenikhena.

data.content:
Nigeria's Super Eagles squad has reported to camp in Uyo as the team prepares for its opening Group L fixtures in the 2027 Africa Cup of Nations qualifiers.

The team faces Madagascar at the Godswill Akpabio Stadium on Friday, September 25, before travelling to take on Guinea-Bissau away.

Super Eagles' camp open for AFCON 2027 qualifier. Photo by Abdel Majid Bziouat/AFP.  
 Source: Getty Images [...] 3 min read

 Super Eagles' training camp opened in Uyo ahead of AFCON 2027 qualifier matches against Madagascar and Guinea-Bissau
 Eric Chelle named a 24-man squad after Victor Osimhen pulled out through injury, with two new invitees included
 Several Super Eagles players impressed for their clubs at the weekend, while others were unused substitutes

PAY ATTENTION: Find it fast with our new search feature at Legit.ng! [...] Coach Eric Chelle assembled a 24-man squad for both games, though he was forced into an early adjustment after Victor Osimhen withdrew due to injury, with Taiwo Awoniyi drafted in as a replacement.

Awoniyi, however, did not feature for his club at the weekend, having been suspended following a red card against Brighton. Coventry defeated Nottingham Forest in his absence
